sections.content: Diagnostic Enablement Behavior

With RIG_RELAY_ALLOW_UNSAFE=1: The unsafe-raw-shell profile is admitted at all boundaries. It appears in ACP listings, passes mode selection, passes AgentManager construction, and passes switch_profile. The profile sets bypass_tool_permissions=True and restrict_raw_shell=False on the bash tool, giving raw shell access. The profile is classified as AgentSafety.YOLO with a description marking it as Diagnostic/developer mode with raw shell access. Without the env var: All boundaries refuse. The refusal message explicitly mentions RIG_RELAY_ALLOW_UNSAFE=1 as the required enablement. The env var check is exact-match (not truthy): RIG_RELAY_ALLOW_UNSAFE=0 returns False.

Pre-Existing Test Failures (Evidence of Gate Correctness)

7 tests in tests/core/test_agent_loop_functional_recovery.py fail because they use agent_name=BuiltinAgentName.UNSAFE_RAW_SHELL without RIG_RELAY_ALLOW_UNSAFE=1. The failure is the ADMISSION GATE WORKING CORRECTLY: ValueError with message Profile 'unsafe-raw-shell' is a diagnostic-only mode that requires explicit enablement. These tests pre-date the admission gate and need a targeted update to set the env var when exercising unsafe raw shell. This is a known pre-existing condition, not a P2 regression.
Normal Profiles Unaffected

All normal agent profiles (DEFAULT, PLAN, ACCEPT_EDITS, MISSION_SCOPED_AUTO, CLEANER, BUILDER, ORCHESTRATOR, LEAN, EXPLORE) pass the admission gate unconditionally. The gate only filters profiles in _UNSAFE_DIAGNOSTIC_PROFILES (currently only UNSAFE_RAW_SHELL). Existing governed mutation, validation, checkpoint, and read-only observation paths remain fully functional.

Discovered Out-of-Scope Risks

None. The admission gate is centralized in one function with 6 invocation points (ACP listing, ACP selection, config init, agent switch, available listing, agent cycle) plus a runtime enforcement layer in the bash tool. No alias bypass, no capitalization bypass, no persisted-state smuggler, no direct-configuration injection path was found. The _UNSAFE_DIAGNOSTIC_PROFILES set centralizes the list of gated profiles.
